newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA says October Bulletin may be delayed.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA says October Bulletin may be delayed.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia said on Friday its October Bulletin scheduled for release on October 16 may be delayed a day due to production problems.
"We've hit some production snags so it's more probable than not the Bulletin will come out Thursday," said an RBA spokesman.
"We'll probably know for sure on Monday."
The October Bulletin includes the bank's assessment of the economy in the September quarter and will be eagerly awaited by financial markets for any insights on monetary policy.
